description: #531 parity: 2D diffusion with 5-point Laplacian rule on periodic square domain. Conditions derived from MOL #531 2D diffusion test at pinned SHA.

tolerance.notes: 5-point Laplacian coefficients are simple rationals in dx/dy; should be bit-identical across bindings to this tolerance.

fixtures.name: diffusion_2d_periodic
fixtures.notes: 40x40 uniform grid on [0,2]x[0,2] (dx=dy=0.05) with periodic BCs. 2D Gaussian IC centered at (1.0,1.0): u(x,y)=(0.5/(2*pi*0.04))*exp(-((x-1)^2+(y-1)^2)/(2*0.04)).
